HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: T-Rex AI is an endless run game where you control a dinosaur navigating through a desert filled with unpredictable obstacles. The game is simple to play but challenging to master.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the spacebar or up arrow key to make your dinosaur jump.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Press the down arrow key to lower your dinosaur's head and avoid high-altitude obstacles.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Stay focused and be ready to improvise as the game speeds up.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: T-Rex AI features simple graphics that help prevent background distractions.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: The obstacles in T-Rex AI are extremely unpredictable, making the game more challenging.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Discover the unique "Bot Activated" feature that adds an extra layer of excitement to the game.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: With its never-ending gameplay, T-Rex AI offers hours of fun and entertainment.
